description: Extract intra-repo import/require relationships for JavaScript/TypeScript and Python. Nodes are files (auto-collapsed to module/directory level for large repos); edges are directed import relationships. Returns JSON. Use this when you need the raw dependency edges — who imports whom — e.g. to reason about coupling, cycles, layering, or the blast radius of a change. Do NOT use it just to draw a picture: generate_diagram returns a ready-to-render draft, and map_repo does the whole flow in one call.

path.description: Absolute or relative path to the repository root

name: build_import_graph
title: Build import graph
